name: Toast notifications
description: Transient messages that stack in a corner and auto-dismiss.

name: Alert banners
description: Inline status messages in four intents — info, success, warning, and error.

name: Tooltip
description: A small label that appears on hover or focus to explain a control.

name: Empty state
description: Placeholder for no-data views — an icon, a line of guidance, and an action.

name: Skeleton loader
description: Shimmering placeholders that mirror the shape of content while it loads.

name: Spinners & progress
description: An indeterminate spinner, a determinate bar, and a circular progress ring.

name: Confirmation dialog
description: A focused modal that asks the user to confirm a destructive action.
